evidence_required: Definitions of the three utilizations and why they multiply.

marking.criterion: Allocation is the fraction of GPU-hours given to jobs
MFU is useful model FLOP/s divided by peak FLOP/s while running; goodput is the fraction of allocated time that becomes durable progress
They multiply because each applies to what remains after the previous one (with an example such as 0.80 x 0.38 x 0.92 = 0.28)

title: Allocation, MFU and goodput
